title: Coleman-Liau Index Calculator
description: Compute the real Coleman-Liau Index from letter and sentence density — no syllable counting needed.
howto: Paste your text into the box.
Letters and sentences are counted per 100 words automatically.
Read the Coleman-Liau Index: the US grade level needed to understand the text.

faqs.q: How is this different from Flesch-Kincaid?
faqs.a: Coleman-Liau uses characters instead of syllables: 0.0588×L − 0.296×S − 15.8, where L is letters per 100 words and S is sentences per 100 words.

faqs.q: What is a good Coleman-Liau score?
faqs.a: Scores map to US school grades: 8 means eighth grade. Aim under 10 for general audiences.

faqs.q: Why is it popular for automated checks?
faqs.a: Because it needs no syllable dictionary — letter counts are exact, so the score is deterministic and fast.
